result.brief: 提出视频场景文本编辑基准 ViTeX-Bench（含配对数据集与三轴评测协议）及参考编辑器 ViTeX-Edit-14B，推动可控视频编辑与评测。
result.reason: Video editing benchmark with paired real-video data, temporal-consistency metrics, and a motion-aligned glyph-video conditioned editor directly serving controllable video generation and evaluation.
